scope: Local adapter describe + static primary route declarations, not public MCP execution

tasks.list.description: Read-only list. limit defaults to 100; offset to 0. include_overdue forbidden.

tasks.create.description: May create/update/cancel a Google Calendar event according to Praxis policy. Completing an existing recurring task may create the next occurrence and its calendar event; completion/reopening can award/reverse XP. Primary-record readback does not certify external Calendar delivery. No delete operation.

tasks.update.description: May create/update/cancel a Google Calendar event according to Praxis policy. Completing an existing recurring task may create the next occurrence and its calendar event; completion/reopening can award/reverse XP. Primary-record readback does not certify external Calendar delivery. No delete operation.

checklist.update.description: Changes title and/or done; does not complete parent task.

habits.list.description: Habit tree. status defaults to active; date selects computed daily state.

habit_logs.set.description: Upsert replaces daily log, not increments. done below numeric target becomes partial; omitted value for done uses habit target. skipped clears value. Compound/since habits reject daily logs.

wellness.get.description: Array, latest 30 records; optional exact date.

wellness.set.description: Full daily upsert (not patch). All fields required to avoid implicit default overwrites.

focus.list.description: Latest 50 sessions, optionally for an exact date.

focus.create.description: Records completed focus duration; does not start a timer.

tasks.delete.description: Deletes checklist, reverses XP and cancels calendar event. Explicit user request only.

tasks.not_today.description: Moves open task to tomorrow and syncs calendar.

habits.delete.description: Deletes habit logs and ritual links; compound children archived. Prefer habits.update status=archived when history should remain.

ideas.to_task.description: Creates task, marks idea promoted and syncs calendar.

projects.create.description: Focus/column changes only when the user requests them; do not choose priorities silently.

projects.update.description: Focus/column/live/objective edits require a user request. expected_revision from latest projects.get is mandatory; conflict requires reread and user review, never blind retry.

reviews.set.description: Full weekly replacement: all fields required, not a partial patch.

finance.status.description: Coverage, timestamps and limitations; no sync triggered.
finance.status.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

finance.overview.description: PF-only Praxis overview with separate unconfirmed pending_card_items (all dates/signs) and coverage. Salary date is a model assumption, not confirmed income.
finance.overview.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

finance.bills.description: Card status, original stale-cycle and manual-payment fields preserved.
finance.bills.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

finance.debts.list.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

finance.installments.list.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

finance.subscriptions.list.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

finance.month.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

finance.transactions.list.description: Deterministic offset pagination, default limit100; separate calls can change as sync runs. matched rows excluded like Praxis API.
finance.transactions.list.transport: fixed SQLite read-only snapshot, Praxis calculation functions

guidance.set.description: Writes today only. Read guidance.get first; expected_generated_at is its timestamp or null. At most 3 priorities; source must be alfred. Never activate until old writer is stopped. Preview validates structure only. Conflict requires reread and user review, never blind retry.

finance.bill.confirm_payment.description: Records a user-reported card payment, never sends money. Preview required; then apply identical payload with returned preview_hash, confirmed_by_user=true and stable request_id. Refuses blocked debts, stale cycles and multiple/ambiguous card debts. Preserves locked/source/note: locked protects against synchronization overwrites, not explicit payment reporting. Payment must be provably after bank_updated_at: paid_on alone works only if the bank snapshot predates that local day; otherwise paid_at with explicit timezone is required and must come from user/payment evidence, never guessed. If snapshot is newer than payment, refuse to avoid double counting. Funding account remains unknown; ledger entry cannot auto-match bank debit. Baseline receipt preserves manual overlay up to 3 business days.

finance.fixed.confirmation.description: Read current-month native fixed-expense user confirmation. No bank reconciliation.

finance.fixed.confirm_period.description: Preview first. Confirm only current Fortaleza month, using preview_hash, confirmed_by_user=true and stable request_id. Marks the native fixed-expense flag, visible in Praxis and excluded from that month commitments. No cash/debt/payment transaction; paid date and amount unknown. Never sets another month.

finance.balance.confirm_zero.description: Preview then apply confirmed zero balance for Mercado Pago only. Preserves bank history; creates source joao balance, no transaction. Newer bank data can supersede. Stable request_id required; uncertain writes never resend.

finance.subscriptions.update.description: Edits existing PF subscription catalogue only. Preview required; stable request_id; rereads after edit. No charge, payment, or vendor cancellation. Account, lane, charge_day and next_charge cannot be changed. Null-account records follow native PF convention. Preflight detects stale previews but native API is not atomic CAS; conflicts/uncertainty require manual reconciliation.

catalog.safety: No arbitrary URL/path/header or unknown fields. Deletes require explicit user request and confirm_delete=true. dry_run writes do not apply changes; fixed-expense previews perform read-only HTTP requests. Reads execute even with dry_run=true. Updates require at least one changed field. Same request_id and canonical operation/payload replays saved result; conflict refuses. Pending never resends; reconcile manually. Audit stores only hashes, operation, status and timestamp. Private idempotency result storage contains user data. Nulls unsupported except guidance.set expected_generated_at when absent. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
